text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes: 16 tests, all OK. I didn't touch the tests.

I fixed these in `catalog/`:
- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist (`catalog.nonexistent`). It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an int.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` added the days to the daily rate instead of multiplying them.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` sliced with `[-n - 1:]` and returned one event too many. It now uses `[-n:]`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3, but the policy comment and the tests say five. It's now 5.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` was missing the "Emma" book, so I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copies there are my own picks. The tests only check the title.
